reviews.text: Would recommend excellent advice and care
Got the best care for my elderly cat. Took time to listen to my concerns and I never felt I was being rushed.
Friendly, great with our dog, very professional manner
Excellent service. Quickly diagnosed the problem and applied the treatment effectively with care. Excellent advice given with appropriate prescription for my dogs ear infection problem.
I’ve been a client of Taylor Vets for 60 years. As always, the staff are friendly, and all really care about pets, and their owners.
Excellent service.
Lovely staff, really transparent and they went above and beyond to make sure things went smoothly when my wife brought our 3 dogs in
Friendly receptionist seen quickly  and the vet was very good and calm with my nervous dog.
Super friendly receptionist Stephane always happy to see and chat about Penny when we are in , a credit to the practice .

Great visit today with Theo and Bella - welcomed with a bright smile by Stephanie, who always comes out and plays with them both and gives them a treat. Thorough 6 month check up given to both. Great customer service by the team there.
Staff very helpfull appointment was on time and instruction from vetenary nurse very clear
My wee cat had messed himself on the way to the Vets. When I said to them about it they were so helpful with sorting him out. Thanks 🐈 …

I've been coming here for a good few years. The staff are always friendly & helpful and always explain everything they're doing or that you need to do. The premises may not be as plush as elsewhere but the service is what counts.

Have been with Taylor Vets for many years with all my pets.
They are professional and always provide a high standard of care.
Catriona is one of the most professional, knowledgeable and kindest of vets.
Efficient,friendly seen on time and with helpful advice
Very pleasant and helpful staff at our dog's annual checkup.
Staff are always great with my nervous girl!
Fantastic Level of local service . Look after my wee old man very well.
Very amenable staff my dog loves to visit, can't wait to get in the entrance.
This was my Border Collie puppy's first vist. The reception staff and vet were excellent. I would highly recommend them.

Amazing service as always from such a fantastic team.
Would highly recommend.
My friends and family wouldn’t go anywhere else.
Great experience when I attended with my dog for his booster.

Fantastic service at Taylor's Sheddens practice - needed an emergency appointment for my dog who needed treatment for an ear infection. He was anxious and distressed and the vet managed the whole situation amazingly🥰 …
The young vet was amazing, she put my cat at ease and was gentle and kind. Made such a difference to the visit which is always stressful with a cat.
A1 service would highly recommend
Excellent service
Great vet.. good service and advice
Thank you for your review Emma
Brilliant kind caring and very professional
